newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti denies Finsiel merger talk.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti denies Finsiel merger talk.

text.p: Olivetti's chief executive Francesco Caio on Thursday denied talk of a merger between Olivetti's Systems and Services company and the Finsiel software company of state-controlled telecoms group STET.
Caio speaking in front of the Senate industry commission said, "There are no plans for the acquisition or merger of systems and services with Finsiel."

He added:"We have a great opportunity before us because markets are heading in the direction in which Olivetti is already a major player. The new information technology market is that of systems and services".
Caio said that Olivetti did not want and was not asking for state help because the group is thinking in a market context and it wants the market to judge the group on this.

He confirmed that Olivetti had no intention of closing its personal computer company, and added that for its PCs and Lexikon office equipment companies it will be its aim to find partners to assure the businesses' future.
The meeting of the Senate commission has now closed.
